```{r generate-predictions, include=FALSE}
# Distributions to compare
dists_to_show <- c("gamma", "weibull", "lognormal", "llogis", "gompertz", "gengamma")

dist_colors <- c(
  "gamma" = "#E41A1C",
  "weibull" = "#377EB8",
  "lognormal" = "#4DAF4A",
  "llogis" = "#984EA3",
  "gompertz" = "#FF7F00",
  "gengamma" = "#A65628"
)

dist_labels <- c(
  "gamma" = "Gamma (selected)",
  "weibull" = "Weibull",
  "lognormal" = "Log-normal",
  "llogis" = "Log-logistic",
  "gompertz" = "Gompertz",
  "gengamma" = "Gen. gamma"
)

# Helper for population-averaged predictions
predict_pop_avg <- function(model, newdata, time_pts) {
  tryCatch({
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "survival", times = time_pts)
    if (".pred" %in% names(pred)) {
      surv_probs <- lapply(pred$.pred, function(x) x$.pred_survival)
      surv_matrix <- do.call(cbind, surv_probs)
      return(rowMeans(surv_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else if (is.list(pred) && length(pred) > 0 && is.data.frame(pred[[1]])) {
      surv_probs <- sapply(pred, function(x) x$est)
      if (is.matrix(surv_probs)) return(rowMeans(surv_probs, na.rm = TRUE))
      else return(surv_probs)
    }
    return(NULL)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Generate predictions for control arm under each distribution
control_data <- data_complete
control_data$Rx <- factor(ctrl_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))

pred_data <- data.frame()

for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
  fitted_models_outcome <- models$full[[outcome]]

  for (dist_name in dists_to_show) {
    model_obj <- fitted_models_outcome[[dist_name]]
    if (is.null(model_obj) || !inherits(model_obj, "flexsurvreg")) next

    pred <- predict_pop_avg(model_obj, control_data, time_points)
    if (is.null(pred)) next

    pred_data <- rbind(pred_data, data.frame(
      time = time_points,
      surv = pred,
      distribution = dist_name,
      outcome = toupper(outcome),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# KM data for reference
km_os <- survfit(Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ 1, data = data_complete[data_complete$Rx == ctrl_rx, ])
km_pfs <- survfit(Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ 1, data = data_complete[data_complete$Rx == ctrl_rx, ])

km_data <- rbind(
  data.frame(time = km_os$time, surv = km_os$surv, outcome = "OS", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(time = km_pfs$time, surv = km_pfs$surv, outcome = "PFS", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
)

cat("Generated predictions for", length(unique(pred_data$distribution)), "distributions\n")
```

```{r create-extrapolation-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(pred_data) > 0) {
  pred_data$dist_label <- factor(
    dist_labels[pred_data$distribution],
    levels = dist_labels[dists_to_show]
  )

  p_extrap <- ggplot() +
    # KM curves (step functions)
    geom_step(data = km_data, aes(x = time, y = surv),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    # Parametric curves
    geom_line(data = pred_data, aes(x = time, y = surv, color = dist_label),
              linewidth = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~outcome, ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(dist_colors[dists_to_show],
                                          dist_labels[dists_to_show]),
                       name = "Distribution") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(time_points), by = 104),
      labels = function(x) x / 52
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Time (years)",
      y = "Survival Probability"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  # Add vertical line at end of observed follow-up
  max_os_time <- max(data_complete$OSwk, na.rm = TRUE)
  p_extrap <- p_extrap +
    geom_vline(xintercept = max_os_time, linetype = "dotted",
               color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = max_os_time + 10, y = 0.95,
             label = "End of\nfollow-up", size = 2.5, hjust = 0, color = "gray40")

  print(p_extrap)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (nrow(pred_data) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure_s2.png"),
    plot = p_extrap,
    width = 12,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure_s2.png"), "\n")
}
```
